weather_report:
In Boston today, a gentle hush of fog wraps the city, lending an air of mystery to the day. As the clouds loom overhead, offering only glimpses of diffused light, one senses the possibility of sporadic rain showers under the overcast blanket. The temperature inched toward 63, encouraging a layered approach to attire; a light sweater under a versatile jacket seems fitting. Comfortable shoes with a touch of waterproofing wouldn't be amiss, as the ground may greet you with dampness.

The evening hours bring the prospect of more persistent rain, enveloped by the same murky fog that shrouded the day. As twilight descends, curling up with a good book by the window may be the perfect way to embrace the cozy ambiance of the indoors. If venturing out, a stroll through one of Boston's quieter parks could provide a taste of the crisp air and the solace of solitude amidst the patter of light rain.
